entities.summary: De Standaard is a Flemish daily newspaper published in Belgium by Mediahuis. It was traditionally a Christian-Democratic paper, associated with the Christian-Democratic and Flemish Party, and in opposition to the Socialist Flemish daily De Morgen. In recent years De Standaard has renounced its original ideological ties. De Standaard is a newspaper in Europe, established in 1918. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
